reason: The behaviour is equivalent and every opcode is real on the 65SC12 (BRA, no BBR/BBS etc.), branch ranges fine, no self-modified operand in the region; old 45 bytes, new 53 (+8, the claim's bytes -8). My own sfx_tick path counts: up-step no carry -1, carry +4, down-step no borrow (sfx_pa_clc now CLC+BRA) +3; dv=0 -8, dv<0 no clamp -2, clamp +3; DEC no end -1, ramp end +4: a typical channel step saves 4-10, so ~5.3 is plausible. But the count is incomplete where the lens requires it: the +8 bytes slide everything after sfx50 in bank 5, and the relies_on's claim that only the sfx region needed checking is wrong. (1) compiled_bank5's ck2_09_u3_draw (a player running-sprite part, render phase, on the critical path): BNE ck2_09_u3_ok1 at &A8ED and BCC at &A8F3 target ck2_09_u3_ok1 &A8F8, which moves to &A900 while the branches stay in page &A8, so the usual taken BNE (whenever &C3 != &7F) costs +1 cycle on every draw of that kind (same in the gameplay build: &A8FE -> &A906). The claim's 'work -3/-1 a pass' says the interrupt saving is mostly hidden in the wait for the flip, so a +1 in the render's critical path on passes drawing that part can cancel or exceed it there. (2) sfx_data moves: sfx_effect_08's first ramp goes &A5F7 -> &A5FF, so sfx_next_ramp's nr_c1_b1..b5 reads cross &A600 on all 5 instead of 3 of its second ramp: +2 cycles per start of effect 08. (3) credits (title only): BNE credit_in starts crossing, BRA credit_end stops. Room is fine (shipping andy_load &AFFE, gameplay &B004 <= &B007). Not counted by the candidate, so its cycle claim is wrong as stated and the net on the critical path is unproven.
